en.name: WGM 202
en.description: After the welding process, protrusions occur at the gasket joints at the corners of the PVC frame, sash and door profiles. This causes various problems in glass installation. With this machine, the end surfaces of the gaskets are milled before welding and by ensuring a smooth connection at the corners, protruding gasket joining problems are eliminated

GENERAL FEATURES: Machine prevents the protrusion issue of gaskets by milling gasket & profile set before the welding process
It has manual revolver with 6 station for different profile systems
Can mill single or double profile at the same time
Can mill 2 pcs of gaskets in the sash profile and 2 pcs gaskets in the base profile
Ability to mill the middle gasket in frames with this type of gasket
